title: Bounded-position reaching
statement: Let $P$ be a register program with oracle, and let $c_0,c_1,c$ be configurations on the same input, with register $r$ and integers $p,L$. If $c_0$ reaches $c_1$ relative to $c,r,p$ and $-1\le p\le L$, then throughout that reaching computation, each intermediate configuration has the head of register $r$ at some position $q$ with $-1\le q\le L$, and the computation still reaches $c_1$.
